scale.basis: 145.0 x 50.0 plate, 68.0 overall with tabs, 2.0 wall, depths 2/3/5/7/10 from DETAIL-D and SECTION C-C (10.0)

frame: Origin at the plate centre in XY. Z up; the deepest pocket bottom is at z=0 and the flange top at z=10. +Y is the side with the tabs at x=±40.5.
body: Flange plate 145 x 50 x 2 with R5 corners, z 8..10
Tabs 14 wide: two at x=±40.5 reaching y=+35, two at x=±23 reaching y=-33
Tray shell with a 2 mm wall: outer x±70.5, y±18.5, z 3..8.5; cavity x±68.5, y±16.5, floor top at z=5
Wall bosses 7 wide around the six plate holes at y=±19, filling the cavity from y=±13 to the wall, z 3.5..10
Deep left pocket: inner x -65..-14, y±10.5 plus x -14..3, y -8..6, floor top at z=2; outer z 0..3.5

features.source: small square near the upper wall

guessed: Depth levels of 2, 5 and 10 were read from DETAIL-D.
The tray width was measured off the plan view.
The hole bosses are modelled as rectangular blocks rather than round notches, so the boolean stays robust.
The narrow part of the deep pocket is assumed to be narrowed on both sides.
10 holes appear in the views, so all 10 are modelled even though the callout says 9X.
